name: 魔眷鸟
evolution: 绿翼鸟 → 魔翼鸟 Lv.20 → 魔眷鸟 Lv.32
description: 似乎并非是自然产生的物种，对魔法的共鸣极强。根据调查统计结果来看，即使是野生的魔眷鸟也曾经有过契约者，怀疑是被制作出之后再放生的。
descriptionEn: Seems not to be a naturally occurring species, with extremely strong resonance to magic. According to survey statistics, even wild Mojuanniao once had contractors, suspected to have been created and then released into the wild.

skills.name: 甜心续航
skills.description: 自己和敌方获得萌化：回复40%生命。
skills.descriptionEn: Both itself and the enemy gain Fairy-ization: recovers 40% of HP.

skills.name: 超级糖果
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己获得萌化：本次技能威力+60。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; gains Fairy-ization: this skill's power +60.

skills.name: 羽化加速
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+20，迅捷。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains +20 to all skill power, and Swift.

skills.name: 砂糖弹球
skills.description: 造成物伤，双方体重差越大，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the greater the weight difference between both sides, the higher this skill's power.

skills.name: 生日蛋糕
skills.description: 驱散自己的减益，自己的增益翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Dispels its own debuffs; doubles its own buffs.

skills.name: 疾风刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，若先于敌方攻击，改为3连击。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1-hit combo; if it acts before the enemy, becomes 3-hit combo.

skills.name: 扇风
skills.description: 造成物伤，若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if it acts before the enemy, this skill's power +50%.

skills.name: 逆袭
skills.description: 造成物伤，本技能能耗每+1，威力+50。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; for each +1 energy cost of this skill, power +50.

skills.name: 月光合奏
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，双方携带的所有精灵每有1层萌化，本次技能连击数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1-hit combo; for each layer of Fairy-ization on all spirits both sides carry, this skill's combo count +1.

skills.name: 龙卷风
skills.description: 造成物伤，迅捷，应对状态：本次技能威力变为1.5倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, Swift; counter state: this skill's power becomes 1.5x.
